title: L1A Module
description: One content file: content/<tier>/<NN>-<slug>.json, e.g. content/emt/02-airway.json. The wrapper carries the module's identity and its lesson order; the concepts themselves are inlined so the app fetches one file per module and no more. lessons[] is the running order and the table of contents; concepts[] is the content. Every concept ID listed in a lesson must have a matching entry in concepts[].

id.description: Module ID: TIER-MM. The prefix of every concept ID inside it, e.g. EMT-02 for Airway.

tier.description: Which rung this belongs to. Matches the content/ subfolder name.

number.description: Module number within the tier, matching the MM in id and the filename prefix. EMT runs 1-11.

title.description: Module name as it appears on screen and in the print footer, e.g. 'Airway, Respiration & Ventilation'.

short_title.description: Compact form for the print footer and card corners, e.g. 'Airway'. Falls back to title.

domain_weighting.description: Share of this module's exam questions drawn from each domain, as percentages that should total 100. A single-domain module is just one key at 100. Lets a module exam mirror the real blueprint weighting instead of sampling flat.

exam.description: Module exam settings. Defaults follow the gating rules in docs/master-plan.md 8.

retake_after_hours.description: Review period before a retake, with a fresh question set.

lessons.description: Lessons in running order. Each lists its concept IDs in teaching order.

id.description: Lesson ID: TIER-MM-LL, e.g. EMT-02-03 for Oxygen delivery.

concepts.description: Concept IDs in the order they are taught. Each must appear in the module's concepts[] array.
The full concept records for this module, inline. Order here does not matter - lessons[] owns the running order.

reviewed_against.description: Source text and guideline edition the module as a whole was reviewed against. Individual concepts may carry their own, which wins.

allOf.description: A review date means nothing without the source it was reviewed against.
